title: DeCO: Discriminative Evidence Composition for Fine-Grained Dataset Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25480v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while preserving its downstream utility. However, existing methods primarily preserve global image statistics and may overlook the localized evidence essential for fine-grained visual classification (FGVC), such as object parts, subtle textures, and region-specific structures. We formulate fine-grained dataset distillation as budgeted discriminative-evidence preservation and propose Discriminative Evidence Composition (DeCO). DeCO uses attention rollout from a pretrained TransFG teacher to identify informative patches, applies spatial diversification to reduce redundant coverage, and organizes the resulting regions into class-wise evidence banks. Multiple same-class regions are then packed into compact grid-composed images. translated_title: DeCO：面向细粒度数据集蒸馏的判别性证据组合
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏将大型训练集压缩为紧凑的合成数据集，同时保留其下游任务的效用。然而，现有方法主要保留全局图像统计信息，可能忽略对细粒度视觉分类（FGVC）至关重要的局部证据，例如物体部位、细微纹理和区域特定结构。我们将细粒度数据集蒸馏表述为预算约束下的判别性证据保留问题，并提出判别性证据组合方法DeCO。DeCO利用预训练TransFG教师模型的注意力回溯来识别信息丰富的图像块，通过空间多样化减少冗余覆盖，并将所得区域组织为类别级证据库；随后将多个同类区域打包成紧凑的网格组合图像。教师模型仅用于数据集构建，下游学生模型则采用标准硬标签监督进行训练。
tldr: 该论文提出DeCO方法，将细粒度数据集蒸馏建模为预算约束下的判别性证据保留问题，利用教师模型注意力回溯定位关键局部区域、经空间多样化去冗余后组合成网格图像，使学生模型仅需标准硬标签监督即可训练。
en_tdlr: DeCO formulates fine-grained dataset distillation as budgeted discriminative-evidence preservation, using attention rollout from a pretrained TransFG teacher to select informative patches, spatially diversify them, and pack them into grid-composed images, enabling students to train with only hard-label supervision.
